senses.gloss: --the dissolution pertaining to प्रकृति; a state in which there is no rain for a century, famine rages and the fire of deluge consumes all spaces, accompanied by violent winds and so on. It is of four kinds; नित्य, नैमित्तिक, प्रा- कृतिक, and आत्यन्तिक; deluge, when the universe merges when the गुणस् are in a balanced state. भा. XII. 4. (whole); M. 1. ३३; वा. 5. 9. [page३-116+ ३६]
--the seven clouds (named) which cause Pralaya. They take their origin from the steam caused by fire and cause the several oceans to become one. M. 2. 8-9.
